 This Petition, Coming On For Admission, This Day,
The Court Made The Following:
 Order

The petitioner is accused No.7, is before this Court calling in question the proceedings in Crime No.38/2022 registered for the offence punishable under Sections 4, 6, 8, 12 and 17 of POCSO Act and Sections 9 and 10 of the Child Marriage Act and Sections 376 and 149 of IPC.
2. The learned Additional SPP on instructions would submit that except the husband, against all other accused the police have filed a 'B' report before the concerned Court.

3. In the light of the 'B' report being filed by the respondent - State, the petition in the form that it is pending is rendered infructuous reserving liberty to the petitioner to avail of the remedy available in law in the event any order would be NC: 2024:KHC:20320 passed by the concerned Court against him, the petition stands disposed of.

Sd/-
